name: M6.Euclid.rank_order
statement: ∀ p q : M6.Euclid.BP, (M6.Euclid.rank p < M6.Euclid.rank q ↔ p.degree < q.degree) ∧ (M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ M6.Euclid.rank q ↔ p.degree ≤ q.degree)
guidance: Split p=0 and q=0; unfold rank and use Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree for nonzero polynomials. The zero polynomial has rank0 and degree bottom. Preserve constants. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.
